syntactic_simplification: Mice are central to neuroscience research. They provide a flexible model for scientists. Researchers can control and study them to learn about the brain. Historically, researchers have preferred male mice. This preference is partly due to concerns about hormonal cycles in females. These cycles can cause behavioral variation. Such variation could affect results.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain research. They are a useful model for scientists. Researchers can manage and examine them to learn about the brain. In the past, researchers have preferred male mice. This choice is partly because of worries about hormone changes in females. These changes can cause differences in behavior. Such differences could influence results.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important in brain research. They are a useful model for scientists to study how the brain works. Researchers can manage and examine them carefully. In the past, scientists have chosen to use male mice more often than female mice. This choice is partly because they are concerned that hormonal changes in female mice can lead to differences in behavior. These behavior differences could affect the results of the experiments.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important in brain research. They are a useful model for scientists to study how the brain works. Researchers can manage and examine them carefully. In the past, scientists have used male mice more often than female mice. This is partly because they worry that hormonal changes in female mice can lead to differences in behavior. These behavior differences could affect the experiment results.
